title: Reliability moments with an unresolved retrieval decision rule
formal_object: Paired raw scalar coordinates q=z+eps_q,c=z+eps_c with independent zero-mean noises of equal variance n and signal variance v; E z=0.
assumptions: Noises are independent of signal and each other, and moment identities precede nonlinear unit normalization.
v,n are nonnegative population variances; clipped sample estimates are not proven optimal.
The LMMSE predictor zhat=r q does not itself derive a diagonal pair-ranking metric.

operations.condition: All stated independence and equal-variance conditions hold

operations.input: A single-observation MMSE objective versus pair ranking
operations.output: The optimal denoising coefficient cannot be transferred as an optimal retrieval score without a ranking model.

derivation_steps.justification: Expand and retain cross terms until independence and zero means remove them.
Differentiate the scalar quadratic when v+n>0; this is a prediction objective for z from one observation.

derivation_steps.statement: Two-sided independent denoising would yield (r q)(r c)=r^2 qc, whereas the legacy score uses r qc.
derivation_steps.justification: The algebra exhibits the absent decision-rule bridge. Neither expression is declared Bayes-optimal retrieval without a candidate generative/label model.

method_expression: PARTIAL: population moments and scalar denoiser only. A complete ranking construction tied to labels/decision risk is not derived; the legacy diag(r) head remains an unqualified heuristic.
distinguishing_prediction: Actual paired raw-feature moments and post-normalization distortions must support the noise interpretation; useful complementary semantics in q-c would falsify it.
falsifier: Independent-noise assumptions fail, or a legal denoiser/diagonal metric explains equal outcomes without the proposed ranking interpretation.
closest_alternative: Wiener/LMMSE shrinkage and ordinary diagonal metrics; formal denoising equivalence does not justify the legacy ranking metric.
decisive_comparison: Before any new experiment derive the decision rule and compare same legal train information, normalization and full native rankings against both simple diagonal controls.
legacy_code_audit: Legacy I17 clips E(qc) and uses diag(r) after unit-normalized PCA features. The assumed additive independent-noise distribution is not preserved automatically.
review_limit: Moment and LMMSE identities reviewed; method_expression pending because retrieval-risk construction and normalization bridge are absent.
